title: Verify: GameLayout desktop Tailwind classes and overflow rules unit tests
summary: Unit tests asserting desktop classes and overflow stylesheet rules
description: Write tests from REQ-1 asserting the Tailwind desktop classes on GameLayout and the overflow rules in styles.css. No browser or server is used.
acceptance_criteria: Root, aside and main classes asserted.

steps.action: Add test 'root grid classes': render GameLayout with scene <div/> and story <div/>, assert container.firstElementChild has classes grid, h-screen, overflow-hidden, md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]; assert the aside has overflow-y-auto and md:h-screen and the main has min-w-0.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layoutDesktop.test.tsx -t 'root grid classes'

steps.action: Add test 'stylesheet overflow rule': read src/styles.css via readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'src','styles.css')) and assert it matches /html,\s*body,\s*#root\s*\{[^}]*height:\s*100%[^}]*overflow:\s*hidden/.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layoutDesktop.test.tsx -t 'stylesheet overflow rule'
